conflicts.subject: predicted equilibrium phases for FeCoCrNiMn at 500 °C
conflicts.claim_a: Thermo-Calc predicts a sigma phase and an FCC phase at 500 °C
conflicts.claim_b: Experimental results demonstrate sigma, BCC and L10 phases in the FCC matrix during prolonged annealing at 500 °C

evidence.quote:
The predicted phase constituents of this HEA at 5 00 ℃ 
are a σ phase and an FCC phase. However, the experimental result demonstrated that 
a σ, a BCC, and a L10 three phases exist in the FCC ma trix during prolonged 
annealing at 500 ℃ [34] . This indicates that the thermodynamic models need further 
refinement.
